The '''Najarka system''' was an outlying [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Najarka]], but otherwise seemed devoid of life. It was considered to be too isolated to be of use for industrial development or settlement.<ref name="WEGTA">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>

It was four hours hyperspace travel from the [[Laim system/Legends|Laim system]] with a standard [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].
